column2: Count rearrangements where nothing stays in its original position
D[k] counts derangements of k items|Base cases: D[0] = 1 and D[1] = 0
There are k - 1 legal positions|Now follow the item displaced from that position
It returns to k: D[k - 2]|It goes elsewhere: D[k - 1]
D[k] = (k - 1) * (D[k - 1] + D[k - 2])|Apply modulo M at each step
Keep only two previous values|O(N) time and O(1) extra space
